name: team-app
description: Team APP mobile-first multi-sport coaching and team operations PWA using Cloudflare Pages/Workers and Neon.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && node scripts/verify-release.mjs && node scripts/verify-auth-transport.mjs && npm run verify:pages-functions
scripts.verify:pages-functions: rm -rf .wrangler-pages-functions && mkdir -p .wrangler-pages-functions && npx wrangler pages functions build functions --outfile .wrangler-pages-functions/index.js --project-directory .
